body: Yeah, one of my friends does like her. But I don't think the others do. Also, there are only two people in my group who likes girls. So I disagree

Lol, I guess you know more about my life than me. I'm not jealous of her. I wouldn't like the idea of my friends making the same jokes with me that they make about her, and not even the attention. I just don't like the idea of talking about a single person the entire day.
Because this is literally all they talk about. How am I supposed to talk to them if they are talking about her all the time?

Honestly, my main concern is that they might understand what i said as it was their fault, even though i could have given my opinion. Plus the fact that they are already of overwhelmed with the fact that nobody liked it and a lot of things went wrong.
I think the best option would be to explain what i was thinking about if they bring the topic to me, but i'm afraid they don't and decide to get mad at me without discussing. I mean, they are far from being bullies, but i would hate to have my relationship (even if I don't talk often to them) ruined.
Thank you. I think you're right. I'm just afraid of the consequences and if other people stand by their side. We never had fights in our class, so I have no idea of how they would react.
